problems.title: Recombination support holds under the explicit premise
claim: The paper assumes Cartesian factor support and relates it to closure under all coordinate-wise two-parent masks.
analysis: Always \(A\subseteq M(A,A)\subseteq\prod_j A_j\). If \(M(A,A)=A\), sequentially select each desired coordinate from an element of \(A\), retaining previously chosen coordinates; closure constructs every element of \(\prod_jA_j\). Conversely a Cartesian product is closed under all masks. This proves support equivalence without implying independent probabilities. Correlated positive masses on a full binary square retain full support after mixing despite changed probabilities.
result: No error is established in this support implication. Appendix A.1 disclaims a theoretical disentanglement guarantee; unavailable full implementation limits empirical reproduction.
